name: Kojimachi
tagline: Toranomon in 10 minutes and Tokyo in 14 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥170,000 to ¥180,000.
summary: The station is in Chiyoda City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 14 minutes to Otemachi, 15 minutes to Shinjuku, 16 minutes to Shibuya and 24 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥170,000 to ¥180,000. The station stands 30.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 11.0 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 30.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 20.8 m to 31.8 m, a difference of 11.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 13 clinics and 17 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 茂恵会半蔵門病院, about 9 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 友仁会赤坂見附前田病院, about 12 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line runs at 153% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 東池袋→護国寺, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 1K ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. 1LDK ¥310,000 to ¥320,000 and 2LDK ¥500,000 to ¥510,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥170,000 to ¥180,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the highest in the 23 wards. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kojimachi. It reaches Otemachi 6 minutes sooner than Kojimachi. One-room rents run about ¥8,000 lower.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 9 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
